Glendalough Single Grain Double Barrel Finish

Glendalough's Single Grain Double Barrel Irish Whiskey begins its maturation process in flame charred ex Bourbon American oak. It is finished in Oloroso casks from Montilla, a small town found in the rolling hills of the Spanish countryside.

700mL/ ABV 42%.
